summary:
I covered all 14 items in the UI fixes list.
- Tokens: bone-500 now meets AA contrast, and a unit test enforces contrast.
- Every route group has a loading skeleton, plus error and global-error pages.
- Sheets animate closed. The confirm and prompt dialogs in projects.tsx are now Sheets.
- Explore sort and the auth mode switch are radio groups. Grid cards respond to arrow keys.
- Small controls are 40 px on phones. Toasts clear the safe area, the tray and a new phone "Make it" bar (below lg) on template pages.
- The job tray is the only poller. It slows down in a background tab and signals finished jobs; Studio and projects refresh on that signal.
- Phones get a "You" sheet, and sign-out on one device is in the rail and in that sheet.
- Cards and template pages show a Demo badge when the current version runs on a demo model.
- Explore has a VIP filter, the home page a "Your favorites" rail, and template pages "More in #tag" rails.
- Projects keep the open scene in ?scene=. Branch, Continue and Buy are disabled while offline.
- The admin model table fits 390 px. Creators can edit the prompt, which publishes the next version.
- The Library filters by project, template, template creator, quality and a UTC date range.
- Full suite: 202/202 passing. Typecheck and lint are clean.

docsNotes:
TOKENS (src/app/globals.css @theme):
- ADDED --color-bone-100 #efe5de: hover text such as `hover:text-bone-100`; it was used in the code but never defined, so no CSS was generated for it.
- CHANGED --color-bone-500 from #85736f to #958480: the quietest text (hints, timestamps, placeholders). New contrast 5.51:1 on ink-950, 5.30 on ink-900, 5.06 on ink-850, 4.74 on ink-800. The old value measured 4.37 / 4.21 / 4.02 / 3.76.
- ADDED --color-ember-200 #ffc4ad: ember hover text; it was used but undefined.
- ADDED --color-sage-300 #bcdcbf: success text; it was used but undefined.
- ADDED --radius-panel 24px and --radius-panel-pin 8px: the larger petal shape. `.panel` sets the radius to 24/8/24/8; `rounded-panel` is also generated.
- ADDED --shadow-float `0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55)`: toasts and the job tray (`shadow-float`).
- ADDED --shadow-glow: two ember-700 layers at 30% (color-mix), under the Create tab button (`shadow-glow`).
- ADDED --animate-sink with @keyframes sink (opacity 1 to 0, translateY 0 to 12px, duration-quick, ease-weave): the sheet exit.
- REMOVED --breakpoint-xs (420px): nothing used it.
- New CSS:
  - `.sheet[open]` rises in; `.sheet[open][data-closing]` sinks out.
  - `.sheet::backdrop` is ink-950 at 75% with blur(4px), animated with the veil-in/veil-out keyframes.
- tests/unit/contrast.test.ts fails if a text token drops below 4.5:1 or a class names an undefined shade.

RUNTIME CSS VARS: --tray-h is set by JobTray; --dock-h is set by MakeBar. Toasts offset by `calc(6rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + --dock-h + --tray-h)` below lg.

EVENTS:
- `hl:job-updated` and `hl:job-finished` (both cancelable, exported from job-tray.tsx) plus `useJobEvents(cb)`.
- A listener that calls preventDefault stops the tray's own router.refresh.
- The tray polls every 3 s when visible and every 15 s when hidden, and catches up when the tab becomes visible again.
